name: Les Aventures de Guirec & Monique : Du pôle nord au pôle sud
The Gardener's Year
summary: Alan Titchmarsh presents a series showing how to keep a garden in good shape during every season.

name: Wild Oman: World of Arabia
summary: An enthralling, visually spectacular journey of Oman's natural world, with unprecedented access to rare creatures and never-seen-before animal behaviours.

name: Back to Barrytown
summary:
It's been 30 years since the world was introduced to the Dublin suburb of Barrytown. Now, three decades on, the actor Colm Meaney – who featured across the trilogy of films – explores the world of Barrytown: the people who populated it, the real lives that inspired it, and those who helped create it. He peers through this fictional window into a brief moment in the history of modern Ireland: a time when the fortunes of the country and its citizens were changing utterly.

Back to Barrytown will focus on the stories, themes and characters of each of the three books, capturing the fanciful daydreams of escape and prosperity, and the down to earth realities of family, friendship and community.

name: DNA Detektiven
summary: The series is not just about world-class research projects, but also about a very atypical professor whose headstrong and courageous pursuit of scientific questions takes him far beyond the established boundaries of science.

name: The Best of Today
summary: Dáithí Ó Sé and Maura Derrane take a look back at highlights of the show, featuring a selection of the best chat, cookery and celebrity guests

name: Tour de France: Súil Siar
summary: The latest highlights from Tour de France 2024, with a review of the event so far.

name: Scéalta na gCorn
summary: 'Tá an áthas orm an corn seo a glacadh' are the immortal words that Gaelic games players and supporters wish to hear when their county or club win the silverware. This second series of Scéalta na gCorn sees Gráinne McElwain on the road again, exploring the fascinating stories behind the trophies presented for competition, from underage matches through to All-Ireland championships. Gráinne meets past and present players, referees and managers, as well as the grassroots supporters and family members who all have a unique story to tell about a cherished trophy.

name: Dáil Éireann
summary: Coverage of today's proceedings in Dáil Éireann

name: Silence is Golden
summary: At the start of each episode, the network gives £250,000 to the studio audience and all they need to do to keep it...is remain silent. With every audience member mic'ed up, all hell breaks loose as a green room of 30 acts, led by three returning comedian captains, headed up by Katherine Ryan, wage war on the audience, with every sound forced out of them bringing the total prize money down. It's entertainers vs audience - they're not on the same side. If the entertainers get the prize pot to zero, they get to give money to charity. Silence is Golden - the comedy show that you can't laugh at.

name: Kake kara Hajimaru Sayonara no Koi
Ovoz
summary:
Ovoz is an Uzbek entertainment vocal talent show.

The main task of this show is to find and select universal vocalists who sing not only in different genres, but also in different languages. An additional feature of the format is that all project participants are selected not by external, but by vocal data. At the same time, due to the lack of genre criteria, participants can demonstrate their vocal abilities to the audience and the jury both in the performance of jazz or rock, as well as folk songs or classical vocals. The participants of the show are mostly established musicians who have passed a certain school of skill, and therefore the mentors of the project do not set the task for the contestants to change, "break" their approach to the repertoire and style, but on the contrary, try to choose the performers closest to themselves in the manner in order to.

name: NewsNight with Aaron Brown
summary: A unique look at the day's headlines and key issues.

name: CNN Newsroom
summary: A comprehensive, live broadcast of the latest breaking news and feature stories from around the globe.

name: Critter Quest!
summary: Your backyard's not as boring as you think! No matter where you live you can find incredible creatures all around- you just need to know where to look for them. Join Host Peter Shriemer on a "backyard safari" and discover all sorts of living things right outside your back door!

name: The Burren: Heart of Stone
summary: Brendan Gleeson narrates a documentary tracing the genetic story of the Irish people, asking if prehistoric farmers irreversibly altered the landscape.

name: The Mosque Next Door
summary:
For the first time in Australia, television cameras were given unprecedented 24-hour access into an Australian mosque for The Mosque Next Door.

Brisbane's Holland Park Mosque is one of the oldest in Australia. Located near Pauline Hanson's former electorate when she was first elected to federal parliament, the mosque has found itself in the firing line amidst growing fears from some in the wider community that Islam is contrary to the ‘Australian way of life'.   

Now, the mosque throws open its doors for a look at a year in the life of the people inside — through the realities of life, love and a struggle for acceptance in modern Australia.

name: Down the Hill: The Delphi Murders
summary: On February 13, 2017, the senseless murders of adolescent girls Abby Williams and Libby German left the residents Delphi, Indiana shaken. Four years later, investigators are still searching for the killer using their biggest clues: a grainy picture and recording of his voice from the victim's phone ordering the girls "Down the Hill." Based on the blockbuster podcast, HLN investigates the evidence and clues to hunt for who killed Libby and Abby.

name: Hunt for Truth: Tasmanian Tiger
summary: Tim Noonan investigates the ultimate wildlife mystery to find out if the Tasmanian tiger, the world's rarest, most elusive animal, is gone for good or just very good at hiding.

name: GBN Tonight
summary: We explore the issues that matter to Britain with big political interviews and debates.

name: The Journey Home
summary: JonMarc Grodi and his guests address the personal obstacles, doctrinal objections, and the irresistible attraction to the Church Jesus founded 2,000 years ago.

name: EWTN Live
summary: Father Mitch Pacwa hosts this interview series designed to teach and prepare people for evangelism; whether the topic is Protestant theology or the nature and dignity of women, or a religious figure such as Mother Teresa or Pope Pius XII; the lively discussions between Pacwa and his invited guests.

name: The World Over
summary: Each week, Raymond Arroyo challenges viewers with important political and cultural reporting and analysis of a wide variety of topics of interest to Catholics and people of faith.

name: EWTN News Nightly
summary: Reports daily bulletins and news, including in-depth analysis on several matters from Washington, DC.

name: EWTN Pro-Life Weekly
summary: The host invites pro-life activists and experts to share their inputs regarding the latest developments pertaining to abortion, assisted suicide, euthanasia and the culture of death.

name: EWTN News In Depth
summary: EWTN's weekly one-hour discussion of current events in the Church, politics, and culture, from a Catholic perspective. Covering the underreported stories and clarifying the Church's position on key teachings, with a focus on the laity's needs and concerns. Hosted by Catherine Hadro.

name: Ano Ko no Kodomo
summary: Sachi and her boyfriend Takara are your average high school couple. They go to school together, hang out, and even engage in the more intimate side of dating. However, as time passes, Sachi starts to get the feeling that something isn't right and decides to buy a pregnancy test. Later, in the bathroom of a family restaurant far from her home, she sees the two red lines that will change both her and Takara's life forever.

name: 366 Days
summary: Yukihira Asuka is 28 and works at the reception desk for a music school. She hears that her high school will soon be abolished and decides to attend a school reunion held at her high school. There, Yukihira Asuka meets Mizuno Haruto. Asuka liked Haruto when they were high school students, but she never conveyed her feelings to him. Asuka and Haruto talk during the school reunion and they learn that they both had feelings for each other and they still feel the same way. Asuka is ecstatic, but, the next day, an unexpected tragedy strikes Haruto. That leaves him in an unconscious state.

name: Только не отпускай меня
summary: Natasha Konopliova works as nurse at a hospital. She lives together with her mother, modestly but with dignity. Meanwhile, in another part of the city lives Lera Kuzina, the daughter of wealthy parents. One day, when a delirious and desperate Lera is about to jump from her balcony, Natasha saves her life. Fate has thrown our two heroines together, giving them an opportunity to help each other.

name: Second to None
summary: Elite cyclists of Lidl-Trek women's team, including two-time Aussie Olympian Amanda Spratt, push boundaries competing in the grueling Tour de France Femmes amid women's sports' soaring popularity.

name: Craig Melvin Reports
summary: The latest breaking news, reporting and coverage of the day's important stories.

name: Woofy
summary: In a household where no pets are allowed, a dog, in cahoots with his little boy master, passes himself off as a stuffed animal. Woofy and Antoine have forged a special bond which has led to Antoine taking the dog home and claiming to have won a stuffed animal at school. From that day on, the dog has been living a secret life. But for both, it's a dangerous game in a household where Antoine's mother, as fussy a housekeeper as there has ever been, has laid down the law: no animals allowed!

name: The Influencer
summary: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram — 77 elite influencers flaunt their skills to strategically draw the most attention in this high-stakes social survival show.

name: Music Mayhem
summary: The most unsettling scandals, secrets and shocking moments in Rock N Roll! These dynamic and dramatic true stories will be re-examined, proving there's always more to uncover.

name: The Cycle
summary: The Cycle is a TIS show- topical, interesting, and smart. All four hosts will take turns facilitating the discussion and bring an interesting voice and background to the topics discussed each day.

name: Tribhuvan Mishra CA Topper
summary: A banking crisis forces CA topper Tribhuvan Mishra to take up sex work. Will this dual existence alleviate his troubles — or create entirely new ones?

name: Martin Bashir
summary: A political television program featuring in-depth commentary by Martin Bashir.

name: 37 Sekunden
summary: The young lawyer Clara Andersen goes beyond all moral limits to have her father, the famous singer Carsten Andersen, declared innocent of raping her best friend Leonie Novak. The situation of the night of the crime seems to be ambiguous, because on the one hand Leonie and Carsten actually had a passionate love affair, but on the other hand the decisive word was "no".

name: Meu Pedacinho de Chão
summary: The colourful village of Santa Fé often has its peace shaken by the conflicts between Colonel Epa and Pedro Falcão, an honest man involved in city politics.

name: Best of The Great Indian Kapil Show
summary: Revisit the laughs, merrymaking and heartwarming moments from Kapil's stage with his gang of celebrity guests.

name: All's Fair
summary: A team of female divorce attorneys leave a male-dominated firm to open their own powerhouse practice. Fierce, brilliant, and emotionally complicated, they navigate high-stakes breakups, scandalous secrets, and shifting allegiances—both in the courtroom and within their own ranks. In a world where money talks and love is a battleground, these women don't just play the game—they change it.

name: Dark Side of Reality TV
summary: Dive deep beyond the infamous makeovers, romances and eliminations that helped define an entire TV genre, to bring you stories you've never heard before from producers, contestants and crew, painting a realer version of the reality world.

name: I Was Actually There
summary:
What if our history was told by the people who were actually there? What if this retelling came with all its unvarnished, irreverent and occasionally contradictory humanity still intact?

I Was Actually There will interview Australians who were there when our most defining and memorable events happened. What was it like to witness the miraculous rescue at the Beaconsfield Mine? Or flee the raging waters of the Boxing Day tsunami? Or wag school to meet the Beatles in their prime?

Through powerful contemporary interviews with diverse and colourful characters, the show will ask these Australians what they saw, how they reacted and how it changed them. While looking to the past, the series will reflect who we are now and examine why these moments still resonate.

previousepisode.name: Sydney to Hobart Yacht Race Tragedy, 1998

name: Maggie Beer's Big Mission
summary:
In Maggie Beer's Big Mission, Australia's food icon, Maggie Beer, leads an ambitious world first social experiment to transform the meals and dining experience at an aged care home.

These resources have been designed by one of the show's experts, Change Care Consultant and Occupational Therapist Elizabeth Oliver, to give you a better understanding of the positive steps taken during the series to work towards improvements for residents and staff.

name: Mark McKinney Needs a Hobby
summary: Follow actor and writer Mark McKinney (SUPERSTORE, THE KIDS IN THE HALL) as he embarks on an epic quest to answer perhaps the most pressing question of our age – who are we when we're not working? Mark travels throughout North America to meet the world's most audacious hobbyists, and the communities of like-minded obsessives who nurture them, all to find that one, true, perfect hobby he can claim as his own.

name: Abracadavers
summary: After the death of his Mom, Chris developed an unhealthy obsession with the hair salon chair that killed her. In order to help him through the grieving process, his best friend Gabriel kidnaps Chris in hopes that a road trip with those closest to him (including the chair) will help him move on. Things get weird when they discover that the salon chair gives those close to it superhuman powers. They then find themselves at a camp for super-powered youth, where they learn how to control their powers.

name: In the Wake of Shadow
summary: In a time of chaos, the fallen lady Du Xinyue faces family upheaval and bravely overcomes adversity. While running a tavern on her own, she relentlessly seeks the truth behind her father's mysterious death. In the end, she finds love with Su Xingluo, and together they defeat the hidden villain threatening their people and protect their home.

name: Abandoned Railways from Above
summary:
All over Britain there are abandoned railways with fascinating stories waiting to be explored from above.

Lost behind old stone walls, buried in forests and hidden in the landscape, 5000 miles of railway and 2000 station remain forgotten.

In every episode we will explore a different lost railway line with its own unique history. We'll reveal the vibrant industries that were once dotted along its route, we'll examine the ingenious engineering that was needed to build it, and we'll see how it transformed the life of people in the cities, towns, and villages that it once passed through.

Across the series we'll be transported back in time to see Britain in a new and surprising way.

name: The Tracker's Diary: Tigers of Nepal
summary: Nepal is known for its Bengal tigers but only 300 remain in the wild. Tracker Casey Anderson is determined to walk in their footsteps.

name: After Baywatch: Moment in the Sun
summary: After Baywatch: Moment in the Sun delivers a nostalgic and insightful exploration of "Baywatch," the cultural phenomenon that defined an era, and an unprecedented look into the stars who brought the world's most famous lifeguards to life. Through dozens of new cast interviews and never-before-seen footage, this docuseries unpacks how the show captured the mythology of California's beach culture, set physical beauty standards for an entire generation, and capitalized on the adage "sex sells.

name: The Tracker's Diary: Bears of Katmai
summary: Join filmmaker Casey Anderson as he embeds in the Alaskan wilderness to follow the largest terrestrial carnivores in the world.

name: Kickasso
summary: Join artist and designer Kickasso in his LA studio where fashion, sports and Hip-Hop culture collide. Kickasso takes the sneaker game to the next level with elaborate, one of one designs for clients like rapper Young M.A, NBA champion Chris Bosh and model Sommer Ray. Experience the method to his madness as he digs into their personal lives to collaborate and design the most epic, custom one of a kind sneakers that truly express the passions of his collaborators.

name: The Silicon Waves
summary: The show tells that since the beginning of the 21st century, under the inspiration of the "Notice of the State Council on Printing and Distributing Several Policies for Encouraging the Development of the Software Industry and Integrated Circuit Industry", a group of ideal and technically minded people The story of overseas students returning from the waves and joining the Chinese chip industry.

name: Made in Korea: The K-Pop Experience
summary:
Made in Korea: The K-Pop Experience is a music experiment like no other. The series follows five boys from across the UK as they are put through the K-pop training process with the goal of launching a new boy band on the global stage.

Cameras go behind closed doors at SM Entertainment for the first time to witness the band working with the world's greatest choreographers, singing songs from the best songwriters, and being tutored by some of the most revered experts in the K-pop business.

name: The Gray House
summary:
The story of the three women General Ulysses S. Grant credited as helping the North win the Civil War.

The series reveals the extraordinary true story of the unsung women who helped turn the tide of the American Civil War in favor of the Union. At its center are a Virginia socialite, her indomitable mother, a formerly enslaved ally, and Richmond's most infamous courtesan—four women operating at the heart of Confederate power. Together, they evolve their Underground Railroad operation into a daring and highly effective espionage network, risking their lives and freedom to help preserve the nation's future and safeguard American Democracy.

name: Meet the Rees-Moggs
summary: Unprecedented access to the notorious Sir Jacob Rees-Mogg, and his extraordinary family as he fights for his political life and fails to keep his seat. Can the Rees-Moggs cope with life in the political wilderness?

name: Jane Smith
summary: Jane Smith centers on a brilliant, tough, and darkly funny defense attorney in the Hamptons. Up to this point, Jane has only cared about winning; however, her world is completely turned upside down when, on the eve of the biggest case of her career, she is diagnosed with a terminal brain tumor. While the investigation becomes more dangerous and deeply personal, Jane refuses to let her death sentence stop her from solving this case.

name: The Greatest
summary: The Greatest intimately explores the incomparable life of Muhammad Ali. The amazing victories and defeats that made Ali a legend, both in and out of the ring, have been well documented and while those landmark events will live in The Greatest, the heartbeat of the story is fueled by all the moments that took place outside of the spotlight. The world remembers an icon, but The Greatest is about a man, a husband, a father, a brother, and a son.

name: Secret History of WWII
summary: Stories and heroes you never knew from World War II.

previousepisode.name: Volume Eleven: Nazi Saboteurs in America

name: Hollywood Black
summary: Hollywood Black chronicles the history of cinema, but from a radically Black perspective. By unearthing personal stories from actors, writers, directors, and producers who fought for their place on the page, behind the camera and on the screen, the series provides a critical reexamination of a quintessentially American story - in brilliant color.

name: Secrets of the Sun with Dara Ó Briain
summary: Dara Ó Briain embarks on a journey of discovery, exploring our relationship with the Sun.

name: Fat Joe Talks
summary: Fat Joe Talks will give viewers unique access into the lives of today's most influential personalities who drive the cultural zeitgeist. In each episode Fat Joe will lead captivating conversations around a wide range of newsworthy topics and will travel throughout the United States to meet these cultural icons in their environment.

name: Jamie: What to Eat This Week
summary: Jamie Oliver shows us delicious dishes we can cook with in-season ingredients from our shops, celebrating an abundance of produce, from vibrant salads and brilliant barbecues to fabulously fruity puds.

name: Lost Ships of WW2
summary: Rob Kraft and his team aboard the research vessel Petrel are in search of the most iconic ships of WW2. Using some of the world's most high-tech camera equipment, their spectacular discoveries can now be seen for the first time in almost 80 years.

name: Sunny Nights
summary: A brother and sister venture from the US to Sydney, determined to grow their new spray tan business, but when they get caught up in the city's criminal underworld, they must figure out how to stay alive, out of prison, and in the black.

name: Science in Archaeology 3.0
summary: State-of-the-art technology meets archaeology! This 4-part series will shed light on the past with a level of detail never seen before.

name: The Story of English Furniture
summary: A series of ten programmes, spanning six centuries, which features Arthur Negus enjoying his favourite subject - furniture. The story, set against the background of historical events, illustrates the many influences that create the style of a period.

name: American MC
summary: Follows a group of 17 motorcycle enthusiasts from across the Southwest, who come together in hopes of forming a real Motorcycle Club

name: Auto Revolution: C-10 Clash
summary: C-10 Builds! We take a pair of classic Chevrolet trucks and build them in two different styles and on different budgets.

name: Choppahead TV
summary: No other biker movies even come close to being as hard as the Choppahead boys in New Bedford, Mass.

previousepisode.name: Historia cała o porządku i strzałach

name: 21 Emon
summary: Having to struggle with keeping up their family hotel business, 21 Emon is trying his hardest to help out his family as the new heir, although his dream is not being in the hotel business his whole life but exploring the wide space as a space pilot.

name: Hidden Sweet Wife
summary: The reporter Su Xiao Xiao, who talked about 'as a sister of Tian Qiao', was married to Xu Yi Chen, the new president of the Xu Group, because of his father's last wish. However, because the Su family fell in the middle of the family, the two were in a state of hidden marriage. As a public figure, Xu Yi Chen has scandals with many celebrities. The seemingly frivolous Xu Yi Chen has always been in love with his childhood sweetheart Su Xiao Xiao. After all kinds of misunderstandings, they accompanied and warmed each other, and Xu Yi Chen silently guarded, no matter how difficult it was. Until Su Xiao Xiao finally discovered the truth and resolved the happy knot, the two smiled and walked hand in hand.

name: Rintje
summary: Rusty is a puppy dog who discovers the world the same way a child does, which makes him recognizable, sweet and touching. Rusty has a good feeling for adventure and he can be quite naughty at times. He goes to school for the first time, celebrates his birthday, has a loose tooth, stays over at granny's and gets his first injection.

name: Ffalabalam
summary: Preschool show set in the village of Ffalabalam.

name: Brinda
summary: Young, socially awkward yet morally grounded SI cadet Brinda stumbles upon a brutal murder with a chilling modus operandi. As the killer slips through her grasp, she faces personal and bureaucratic turmoil, but the hardest challenge is the moral reckoning that could define her career and conscience. Will Brinda uphold justice, or lose herself in the chaos closer to home?

name: Pehla Pyaar - Less Than 1% Chance
summary: A young Murli Sharma relocates to Patna from Ratlam with his family after his father transfers there. While he struggles with disconnect and isolation from his peers, he encounters Nandini and their blossoming friendship turns into love for Murli. Will Nandini reciprocate his feelings?

name: The Energy Behind Team Ireland
summary: David Gillick celebrates the people and sponsors who have encouraged and inspired Team Ireland's Olympic athletes.

name: Road Trip Masters
summary: Road trip with schoolteachers, Nick and Brian, in their 1968 gold drop top Cadillac. Touring small-town Americana, this duo takes you along for the ride as they get up close and personal with the awesome people and places that make this great nation rock!

name: The Adventures of Mansour: Age of AI
summary: The Adventures of Mansour: Age of A.I. is aimed at kids ages six to 12, and focuses on artificial intelligence, technology, climate change and space exploration. It revolves around a 12-year-old boy who accidentally creates an evil technology called Blink. With the support of his closest friends, Mansour must face the chaos and danger Blink causes in Salam City.

name: Hello Neighbor: Welcome to Raven Brooks
summary: Hello Neighbor: Welcome to Raven Brooks focuses on the new girl in the neighborhood, Trinity, who moves in across the street from creepy neighbor, Mr. Peterson and quickly befriends Nicky, who is already obsessed with finding out what horrific secrets are hiding in Peterson's basement.

name: Operaatio Valhalla
summary: Alina Railo joins an expedition to Finnish Lapland, seeking access to a parallel universe potentially holding solutions to the climate crisis. Her late father initially investigated this universe before vanishing there decades ago.

name: The Talent Test
summary: The Talent Test is based on the premise that most people have untapped potential and a hidden talent waiting to be discovered, whether it's singing, dancing or playing an instrument. There will then be an "expert" team to help them learn, develop and showcase their newly discovered skill.

name: ArenaBowl
summary:
The ArenaBowl is the championship game of the Arena Football League. Originally hosted at Pittsburgh's Civic Arena based on home attendance during the inaugural 1987 season, save four years (2005–2008) the game was hosted by the team with the higher seed based on regular season performance. In 2005–2006 the league staged the game in Las Vegas, and in 2007–2008 New Orleans hosted the event. For the series final two games, regular season home attendance between the competing teams determined which would host.

Originally using year-based nomenclature ("ArenaBowl '87"), the league would begin consistently referring to the game using roman numerals beginning in 1994 ("ArenaBowl VIII"). The original Arena Football League's 2009 bankruptcy liquidation brought the league's existence to a close, but ArenaBowl XXIII would be staged in 2010 as the championship game of a new league which assumed the AFL's intellectual properties. The final ten games of the series would be staged under the "new" Arena Football League, concluding with ArenaBowl XXXII between the Albany Empire and Philadelphia Soul. The second AFL ultimately had the same fate as the first, ceasing operations after its 2019 season and undergoing Chapter 7 bankruptcy liquidation.

The ArenaBowl will be revived in 2024 and will be played at a neutral site.

previousepisode.name: ArenaBowl XXXIII: Albany Firebirds vs. Billings Outlaws

name: Otroliga Spelen
summary: Some of our most beloved athletes compete alongside some of our funniest entertainers in Olympic disciplines from yesteryear. Program leader Erik Ekstrand will let them try out disciplines such as javelin with the wrong hand, poetry, artistic swimming and many more. Which team will emerge victorious in the 2024 Incredibles Games? The couples are Christian Olsson and Sofia Dalén, Emma Green and Daniel Nannskog, Angelica Bengtsson and Andreas Lundstedt, Michel Tornéus and Elaf Ali and Alhaji Jeng and Torbjörn Averås Skorup.

name: Aviram Katz
summary: Follows a successful author of thriller books, who has been in a writing barrier for a long time and also an offer to publish a story in sequels in a newspaper fails to rescue him from the barrier. Salvation comes from the neighbor, Dr. Victor Guetta. Guetta asks Aviram to give his opinion on a story he wrote. Aviram, who hates requests of this kind, approaches the reading reluctantly and is amazed: this is the most beautiful story anyone has ever written. Aviram decides to steal the story. He sends the story to the system, not knowing what a whirlwind his life is about to enter as a result of the act.

name: Poly Is the New Monogamy
summary: Three girls living in New York City explore modern day relationships, always finding themselves with more than "one" in their lives.

name: Paris 2024 Paralympics: Meet the Athletes
summary: It's time to start getting excited about the Paralympics! And what better way could there be than meeting some of the amazing British athletes we'll all be cheering on this summer?

name: Marcus in the Med: Mallorca
summary: Marcus Wareing explores the culinary delights of Mallorca, a food lover's paradise.

name: История на миллион
summary: Some incredible and funny story has happened to each of us at least once in our lives, which means that absolutely anyone can become a participant in the new show of Garik Martirosyan's stories. In each issue, there are 100 people in the hall, half of them are participants, the other half are viewers who will evaluate them. The task of the participants is to tell their two—minute story to Garik and his star guest, and most importantly — to make the audience laugh, which puts up points. Whoever scores the most points will be the winner and will receive a cash prize. At the end of each issue, the star will tell his funny story. If her story turns out to be funnier, according to the audience, then the winner leaves with the money he earned earlier. If the star loses by points, then the winner's winnings increase to 1 million rubles!

name: Dating Naked
summary: A man and a woman date two naked suitors and analyze what they've learned from their dates.

name: На стиле с Глюк'oZой
summary: The first make-up show in which transformation reaches a new level – the project psychologist will determine the personality type of the participant in the program, and the project team will create a new style for her, select a variety of images, and also change the interior of the apartment so that life plays with new colors.

name: Гудбай
summary: In the story, US President Joe Biden flies to Russia undercover to find out how his sanctions policy has affected the lives of Russians. Russian Russian patriot Joe loses his documents on the very first day, but he finds a new friend — a real Russian patriot who becomes his guide in Russian adventures and the knowledge of that mysterious Russian soul. Biden gets a job as an English teacher at a regular school and lives in Khrushchev. Meanwhile, CIA agents are taking a Russian pensioner Ivanich, who looks very similar to Biden, to the United States.

name: Третье сентября
summary:
Vitya is preparing for the wedding with Masha, the love of his life, and in the evening before the celebration he goes for a drink with friends. Waking up in the morning after a stormy night, Vitya discovers that he does not remember anything about the previous night, and the bride leaves him and leaves.

Overcome with despair, Vitya begs fate to return his wedding day so that he can fix everything. And, as if in response to his pleas, the next morning he wakes up on the same day — September 3.

name: Демис и Марина
summary: Popular comedians and Comedy Club residents Demis Karibidis and Marina Kravets present their own sketch show. The artists will appear in the most unexpected images, reveal the inside of show business and let the audience into their everyday lives. Each episode is a separate storyline in which the couple will play out familiar life situations, human relationships, and everything that each of us faces on a daily basis.

name: Звёзды в джунглях
summary:
The show "Stars in the Jungle" will feature 19 popular artists. From the first day, 10 people will live in the jungle camp, and the rest will appear after someone from the first team leaves. The main task of the participants is to earn coins on difficult challenges, which can be spent on food or taken away as a cash prize – it all depends on the choice of stars. The maximum winnings can be more than 30 million rubles!

Every week, one of the participants leaves the project in the traditional voting for this format, which means that the audience will again witness intrigues, conflicts, coalitions, conspiracies and everything that makes a cool reality show a real reality!

name: Business Today
summary: Bringing the latest business news and up-to-date informed analysis from London and around the world.

name: Bie Zou Hao Ma Bie Xi Jun
Mama Go!
summary: In order to save his seriously ill mother, Xiao Can trades his own life. After recovery, his mother returned to her 20-year-old appearance, but Xiao Can could encounter an accident at any time, so he decided to help his mother fulfill her dream while he was alive. This is a remarkable journey where Kong Guifang, together with her son and young friends, grows and evolves into a new woman.

name: One Life to Live
summary: Beneath its seemingly placid small-town facade, the fictional town of Llanview, Pa., frequently simmers with tension, usually caused by the town's three main families: the upper-crust Lord family, the powerful Buchanan clan and the feisty Cramer family. While the long-running television serial was canceled by ABC in 2011, production company Prospect Park picked up the Agnes Nixon drama and turned it into an online program in the United States. Many fan favorites have returned to the show in its online incarnation, and their characters continue to keep the streets, boardrooms and bedrooms of Llanview hopping.

name: Игры без границ
summary: A large-scale project in which pairs of athletes from all over the world compete to defend the honor of their country: Russia, China, Iran, Belarus, USA, Uzbekistan, Brazil, India, Kazakhstan. They will have to go through vivid, epic and large-scale tests. There are 64 athletes in the season, of which 16 participants represent Russia. All athletes are divided into pairs (male-female), the winning pair will receive the main prize - the championship trophy, as well as 10,000,000 rubles.

name: Свадьба вслепую
summary: Russia's main matchmaker Roza Syabitova and clairvoyant Fatima Khadueva will marry people who do not know each other. "Newlyweds" will live together for a week, will lead a joint household and get to know each other better. At the end they will have to make a decision: stay together or part forever.

previousepisode.name: Выпуск 13. Шеф-повар Михаил и диджитал-редактор Анастасия

name: TechXplore
summary: One of the best ways to understand any country is through its latest innovation. BBC tech reporter Paul Carter is on a mission: to explore destinations across the globe, hunting down their cutting-edge tech and the people who are creating it.

name: Talking Business
summary:
On Talking Business BBC presenters, based in the world's most dynamic cities, discuss with the most important and influential people from the world of business and finance, the key issues of the day.

Corporate leaders, global investors, top creatives, cutting-edge entrepreneurs and leading intellectuals gather together weekly to discuss and analyse the issues and trends that most affect how business has to work in today's world.

Our team of presenters are experts on the issues and developments which are shaping the way we work, consume and live in the 21st Century.

Each takes their turn to host the programme in the business capital they know best. They include Tanya Beckett in London, Michelle Fleury in New York, Yogita Limaye in Mumbai and Lerato Mbele in Johannesburg and Karishma Vaswani in Singapore.

name: BBC News Now
summary: All the big stories, live as they happen, presented by Lucy Hockings.

name: Business Today - NYSE Opening Bell
summary: Bringing the latest business news and up-to-date informed analysis from New York and around the world.

name: Verified Live
summary: Matthew Amroliwala presents all the latest global and UK news, live from London.

name: Focus on Africa
summary: The biggest African and international stories from the BBC.

name: The World Today with Maryam Moshiri
summary: Watch the best of the BBC's journalism from around the world.

name: Eye Investigations
summary: Documentary series offering high-impact investigations and in-depth reporting from our award winning World Service team across the globe.

name: Scams & Scandals
summary: The stories of some of the UK's biggest scams and scandals. The people fighting to have their voices heard, get their money back and the investigations into uncovering the truth.

name: Made for TV with Boman Martinez-Reid
summary: Made for TV is a hilarious unscripted docu-comedy series that follows social media star Boman Martinez-Reid as he tries to make the jump from Content Creator to Television Icon. With the guidance of a celebrity advisor, each episode features Boman as he tests out a different genre of TV with the hopes of finding one that will propel him to television fame. Which turns out, is not an easy feat.

name: Ángela
summary: Ángela leads a seemingly idyllic life from the outside: she has two fantastic children, a charming husband and a spectacular house. However, this facade is a fraud and it costs more and more effort to maintain it. Angela is actually a woman abused by an obsessive husband who has convinced her that without him she would be nothing. Until one day Edu appears, an attractive young man who reveals surprising secrets to her and who is willing to help her by eliminating him from her life.

name: Densetsu no Head Sho
summary: Yamada Tatsuhito is a second-year high school student. He stopped going to school due to bullying. His parents, who have no interest in Yamada Tatsuhito's well-being, have travelled abroad for work. Yamada Tatsuhito is all alone, and he lives alone. One day, he happens to see Ijuin Sho get into a motorcycle accident. Ijuin Sho is the leader of the largest delinquent gang known as Grand Cross. Contrary to his slender physical appearance, he is a strong fighter who has never lost a one-on-one fight. Due to the motorcycle accident, Ijuin Sho is seriously injured. Ijuin Sho also sees Yamada Tatsuhito, who looks just like him. He gets Yamada Tatsuhito to act as his double, but will he be able to survive as a gang leader?

name: Тайны будущего
summary:
Presenter Dmitry Savkin will talk about the problems of humanity, which threaten to be reborn into the apocalypse. They are always with us, and we do not attach much importance to them. What can we do against them and why can any apocalypse be prevented?

Each episode of the project is dedicated to a specific issue. Predictions and prophecies, eternal youth, yeti and other mythical creatures, mold, food of the future, cyborgs, archaeological finds, mushrooms, aliens — these are just some of the topics that will be covered in the "Secrets of the Future".

name: Romance in the House
summary: A drama depicting the story of imperfect humans meeting as a family and dreaming of perfect love.

name: Elvis och Nya Vikingarna
summary: In 2017, Sweden's all-time biggest dance band Vikingarna reunites, now with Elvis impersonator Kenneth Wahlberg as a new singer. However, the rehearsals barely have time to start before conflicts break out between Kenneth and the other members. Now, six years after the New Vikings fiasco, Kenneth wants to find out what went wrong.

name: Bad Memory Eraser
summary: A nourishing romantic drama about a man whose life is changed with the eraser of bad memories and a woman who holds his fate.

name: Your Honor
summary: The story of the forces that inherited wealth centered around the Woowon Group headquarters in the fictional Woowon City adjacent to the sea, the voodoo cartel that dominates the lawless area, and Judge Song Pan Ho, who comforts citizens seeking justice.

name: Γοργόνες
summary: Ioli, a mermaid convince her sister Kalliroi to become human in order to came to the surface and find the man she loves, Konstadis.

name: The Yorkshire Vet: At Home with the Greens
summary: Celebrating the everyday lives of two of Britain's oldest farmers: Steve and Jean Green.

name: Britain Behind Bars: A Secret History
summary: Rob Rinder uncovers a secret history of Britain going back centuries hidden behind our prison walls - from petty crooks to infamous gangsters, hangmen, extreme brutality and explosive riots.

name: Temptation Island México
summary: Til Temptation do us part! Couples who find themselves at a crossroads, travel to a tropical paradise to look for answers and test their relationship. Will the couples be able to resist in betrayal with the sexy tempters? Our hosts, Mexican popstars Sergio O'Farrill and Angie Taddei steer the journey on whether participants will commit to a forever relationship or go their separate ways.

name: Крыса
summary:
They are in their early thirties, and they are successful, accomplished residents of the metropolis. Natasha is a doctor, her husband Vincent is a French journalist, Igor is a promising and in-demand architect, his sweet, smiling wife Anna is a certified psychologist. Couples communicate a lot and willingly. However, neither Anna nor Vincent suspect that Natasha and Igor are secretly dating. This is not just a love adventure. Both Natasha and Igor seem to be in serious love with each other.

Both realize that they made the wrong choice sometime in their lives and are preparing to leave their families. It is extremely difficult for Natasha to decide on such a step, but after all, the relationship with Igor is really very serious, he loves her, gets along well with her child and dreams of having children with her together. Of course, she feels sorry for Vincent, but their relationship has long lost its former sharpness, especially since he is burdened by life in Moscow, and Natasha never wanted to hear about leaving for France forever. Having convinced herself that it would be better for everyone, Natasha finds the courage to declare her decision

name: Кровинушка
summary: In a small seaside town there is a unique clinic "Nadezhda". Spouses Olga and Sergey help women get pregnant - they treat ailments associated with disorders of the reproductive system, as well as infant pathologies. They do wonders in helping women become mothers, but ironically they themselves cannot experience the happiness of giving birth to their own child - a blood baby.

name: GG Precinct
summary: Words can kill — especially when they become the morbid inspirations of a twisted killer. A thrilling spinoff from the creators of "Marry My Dead Body."

name: Morbidelli Rising
summary: Franco Morbidelli enters MotoGP as Moto2 World Champion. Now, the graduate of Valentino Rossi‚Äôs Riders Academy could be set for a debut to remember.

name: À propos d'Antoine
summary: The series will tell the story of Julie who, when she begins a new love life with Marc, finds herself sucked into an extraordinary family. She becomes the mother-in-law of two children, including Antoine, who is polyhandicapped (level 3 autistic, intellectually impaired, non-verbal and high-level epileptic).

name: Mountain Doctor
summary: Ayumu Miyamoto is a young orthopedic surgeon. He goes back to his hometown in Nagano Prefecture and begins to work at the general hospital there. In addition to working as an orthopedic surgeon, he is ordered to join the mountain medical treatment team. The team provides treatment for patients who became sick or injured while in the mountains. The medical team members need to have knowledge about both the mountain and medicine. They are called mountain doctors because of this. Ayumu Miyamoto is not passionate about his duties on the mountain medical team. Things change as he works more with the team members. Meanwhile, Gakuto Emori is a circulatory physician who works at the same hospital and is a member of the medical treatment team. Although Gakuto Emori does his job well, he has trauma from his past that he tries to overcome.

name: The High Street Shops we Loved & Lost
summary: The High Street Shops We Loved & Lost travels back to the high street of yesteryear to celebrate the favourite shop brands that we've loved and lost, from Woolworths to Wimpy, Top Shop to Tammy Girl, Blockbuster to BHS.s Eamonn Holmes, Anne Hegerty, Rufus Hound, Nick Hewer, Lesley Joseph and Penny Smith.

previousepisode.name: The High Street Shops We Loved & Lost

name: Your Kitchen Through Time
summary:
In this nostalgic two-parter we chart the transformation of the British kitchen from the 1950s to the present day. TV chefs including Phil Vickery and Ken Hom, and design experts and historians reveal the trends and social changes that shaped the look and design of our kitchens over the decades.

Celebrities Janet Ellis, Danny John-Jules and Jenny Eclair road-test the must-have gadgets of the day, from the Kenwood Chef to the Spiralizer, discovering which should grace our countertops and which should be shoved to the back of the kitchen cupboard.

Plus, we discover the adverts that sold us everything from flat-pack kitchens to the Breville sandwich toaster, and we reveal how the kitchen was represented in the sitcoms of yesteryear.

name: Terror at 30,000 Feet
summary:
Every day there seems to be another plane disaster. Turbulence killing passengers. Aircraft doors blown off mid flight. Drunken passengers. Mechanical failure. Attempted hijacks. Terror.

In this series we air stories of the most dramatic, jaw-dropping and terrifying airline disasters and aviation incidents ever - all told by the people who were there. Using dramatic reconstruction, special effects and first-hand testimony, Channel 5 takes viewers into the cabin and the cockpit as passengers and crew experience the worst flights of their lives.

name: Zoo Vets
summary: Meet the ultimate medical multitaskers, the men and women tending to thousands of species at zoos and aquariums across the country.

name: The Final Journey of the Greatest Generation
summary: WWII heroes take us on one last journey through their incredible experiences, fighting against the Axis powers in Europe and the Pacific.

name: Path to Paris: The Hunt for Gold
summary: This two-part series follows British athletes as they prepare for the most prestigious event in sport – the Paris 2024 Olympics and Paralympics Games. With intimate access to their training and home lives, we'll see how the athletes, supported by coaches, parents, loved ones and backed by National Lottery funding, have invested everything to get to the start line in Paris this summer. With unique insights into the mental and physical preparations, we share in every triumph and setback on the ‘Road To Paris'. Featured athletes include Keely Hodgkinson, Josh Kerr, Jonnie Peacock and Hannah Cockroft.

name: Devuélveme la vida
summary: The young and fierce daughter of a wealthy landowner falls for a charismatic young laborer — only for their families to tear them apart.

previousepisode.name: Capítulo Final: Se define el destino de Rogelio y los Azcárate

name: Love of My Life
summary: The Gonzales family is not like any other, Isabella, the matriarch, is a rich widow with high standards who would stop at nothing to get what's best for her family. Nikolai, her youngest son, has grown into a rebellious man after causing a traumatic family accident which led to the death of his father. Stefano, the favorite son, is a family-oriented architect who fathers the child of Kelly, his former lover who holds a vengeful heart due to what she has been through in the name of love. When Stefano crosses paths with Adelle, a widow with a child who manages her own handicraft business, things begin to get better.

name: Resident Playbook
summary: Set at the Jongno branch of Yulje Medical Center, the series follows the hospital lives and turbulent friendships of young obstetrics and gynecology residents who proudly enter the unpopular department in an era of low birth rates.

name: R.I.P. Aimons-nous vivants !
summary: Anne-Lise's life is turned upside down when her father leaves her the management of the funeral company he founded upon his death. She who had done everything to get away from the city of her childhood and especially from this morbid business is as if brought back by destiny. While she saw this responsibility as a burden, the single mother will gradually realize that this may be the opportunity for her to solve all her problems! Starting with her unhealthy need to interfere in people's lives. Especially when these people are grieving clients looking to solve their personal problems. To do this, she will be able to count on the help of her loyal and atypical employees and thus prove to the world that there is no wedding without tears and no funeral without laughter!

previousepisode.name: La vie vous va si bien ! 2ème partie

name: Die Wahrheit über Franco – Spaniens vergessene Diktatur
summary: Francisco Franco is regarded by many as one of the most brutal dictators in European history. Spain is marked by his tyranny even today and the Spanish Civil War and nearly 40 years of dictatorship are overshadowed by many questions. What really happened back then? Who was the man who still divides Spain today? What induced young people from all over the world to take part in the Spanish Civil War. How was life in the dictatorship  at all possible? On the basis of the latest research findings, "The Truth About Franco" casts new light on "Spain's Forgotten Dictatorship".

name: Area 51
summary: Area 51 follows the humans and Aliens that work together at the country's most mysterious place.

name: The Murderous Scissor Sisters
summary: A look back on one of the most gruesome and brutal cases in Ireland.

name: Yedi Numara
summary: A couple with no kids, four city girls and three country boys, all under the same roof: arguing, fighting and sometimes understanding they are not that much different.

name: In Defence
summary: A sharp barrister teams up with a strong-minded solicitor - his former lover - to take on shocking and controversial battles within the British legal system.

name: Можно без политики?
summary: In the early 2000s, Russia experienced depoliticization, and culture played an important role in its formation. We tell you what kind of depoliticization it was, and how traces of the "non-political" nature of those years remained in Russian culture for a long time, making it easily controlled by the authoritarian government.

name: The Black Widower: The Six Wives of Thomas Randolph
summary: Thomas Randolph has been married six times, and four of his wives are dead. Several died under mysterious circumstances, leading some to call the Nevada man a "Black Widower." Is Randolph really a calculated killer, or is he simply unlucky in love?

name: С нуля
summary: "From Zero" is a show about the music of the new era. These are ten music projects that could only appear now. At the helm are young people open to the world. They move freely, speak and sing in different languages about what they want. Their work now is a living reaction to radical changes.

name: Contraband: Seized at Sea
summary: Television crews become embedded within U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers and Homeland Security Investigations agents to uncover the hidden world of smuggling; from well-established cartel operations to wild party boats returning from the Caribbean, Contraband: Seized at Sea takes a look at all sorts of nefarious activity happening on the water; filled with major drug busts and exclusive investigative insights, the series follows the realities of law enforcement taking action on the high seas.

name: Breaking Dad: Britain's Unlikeliest Drug Dealer
summary: When police raided a luxury London apartment, they expected to catch a ruthless criminal mastermind responsible for flooding the capital with crystal meth. Instead they found Britain's unlikeliest drugs dealer - a middle-aged, mild-mannered coin dealer called Richard Lubbock.

name: My Family Mystery
summary: Join Sonia Gray on a thrilling journey to help Kiwi families with a mystery to solve. From a single clue, Sonia and a crack team of experts track down answers wherever the story may lead.

name: Chimp Crazy
summary: Former nurse-turned-exotic animal broker Tonia Haddix, who refers to herself as the "Dolly Parton of chimps," spends her days caring for animals in captivity. However, her limitless love for one chimpanzee in particular spins into a wild cat-and-mouse game with authorities and an animal rights group. Through Tonia's and other "chimp mom" experiences, Chimp Crazy reveals the singular bonds that form between owners and their highly intelligent great ape pets. The series exposes the risks humans take when they try to raise these animals as members of their family, as well as the risks to the welfare of the animals themselves.

name: GMFB: Overtime
summary: GMFB: Overtime will cover game topics, as well as the entertainment and lifestyle surrounding the NFL.

name: Sportsday
summary: A round-up of the day's sporting action, plus talking points, analysis and original journalism.

name: The Derbyshire Auction House
summary: Irita Marriott, one of the few women in the country to helm an auction house, and her team use their expertise to launch Britain's newest saleroom.

name: Menendez Brothers: Victims or Villains
summary: Lyle and Erik Menendez were two greedy rich kids from Beverly Hills who murdered their parents for their inheritance, or so it seemed. But a swirl of media and politics influenced this infamous case.

name: Spanish Empire: Rise and Fall
summary: Spanish Empire: Rise and Fall is a gripping documentary series that delves into the fascinating and murky story of the Spanish Empire's conquest of the New World. The series takes an unprecedented look into the brutal legend of the Spanish Conquistadors and uncovers the truth of this dark chapter in human history.

name: Wild Winter
summary: An exhilarating, chilly but heartwarming journey through breathtaking landscapes and their incredible animal species that have not only adapted to survive, but in many cases, thrive in the inhospitable sub-zero climates.

name: Mies joka kuoli
summary: Finnish mushroom entrepreneur Jaakko plods through his life, until the doctor's diagnosis, his wife's rejection, and threats from the local mushroom mafia turn his life upside down.

name: Photos That Changed the World
summary: A startling, in-depth look at the most iconic events in recent history through the unique lens of the photographers and images that made them famous, this series explores the stories behind twelve of the most iconic and unforgettable photos of all time.

name: Surgeons: Life in Their Hands
summary: Fly-on-the-wall series following the patients and staff at Royal Prince Alfred Hospital in Sydney, Australia

name: Something Very Bad Is Going to Happen
summary: A bride has a feeling that something horrifying will happen at her wedding — and the closer to the altar she gets, the worse it becomes.

name: Теоретики
summary: The action of the series "Theorists" takes place in the dormitory of a closed town of nuclear scientists, where young scientists come to launch the next power unit of a nuclear power plant. Here you meet a nuclear physicist, a biological chemist, a mathematician, just a techie who is ready to fix everything that breaks, and a charming blonde who dreams of a prince.

name: Homesteads
summary: Stories of homesteads through the eyes of the ahi kā that are maintaining and strengthening Māori ties to their tūrangawaewae.

name: Шестое чувство
summary: A team of six people takes part in the game. At the beginning of the game, participants are given a minute to discuss who will go on what test. There are a total of 6 stages in the game, each of which will test one of the player's five senses, and at the final sixth test it will be known how much money the team will take with them.

name: The Hunters
summary:
The Hunters will see investigative crime journalist Adam Shand and "The Human Lie Detector" Steve van Aperen join forces to crack famous crimes wide open.

Using skills honed across decades of experience, they uncover new leads and evidence, leaving police no choice but to re-open cases.

Each episode examines a different high-profile case. Adam and Steve revisit crime scenes for a hands-on recounting of each crime, and with exclusive access to original detectives, eyewitnesses, survivors and crime experts, they paint a visceral picture of murders, kidnappings, horrific attacks and underworld assassinations.

name: Шестое чувство
summary: The documentary series explores human supernatural abilities. In each episode of the program, famous actor Vadim Demchog talks about the most incredible and mind-blowing possibilities, such as telepathy, clairvoyance, the ability to control the weather, attract wealth and much more. What is this - a gift of nature or the result of long and persistent training of consciousness? Answers to these and many other questions in the "Sixth Sense" project. The program involves experts, as well as people with phenomenal abilities.

name: Стиляги-шоу
summary: Stars of cinema, music, sports and television demonstrate dance numbers from popular films, cartoons and video clips. They must show the jury not only plasticity, but also a creative and humorous approach to production. Thanks to the choreographers and makeup artists of the project, the stars are completely transformed.

name: Мобильные блондинки
summary: They are young, talented, rich and they are blonde! The heroines of the reality show Tonya, Olya and Lena decide to create their own pop group, enlisting the help of a professional...

name: Unan1mous
summary: Italian version of the American program of the same name

name: The Queen of Villains
summary: The Queen of Villains unveils the untold story of Dump Matsumoto, a professional wrestler who ignited a boom in women's wrestling in the 1980s with her cult-like following. Unlike the iconic "Crush Gals" duo, Chigusa Nagayo and Lioness Asuka, Matsumoto made her mark as the most famous heel. Dominating television screens, they became a cultural phenomenon, captivating Japan.

name: No Gain No Love
summary: A comical romance between a woman who faked marriage because she didn't want to lose money and a man who became a fake groom because he didn't want to hurt a woman.

name: Billy & Dom Eat the World
summary:
Actors Billy Boyd and Dominic Monaghan, stars of cinema blockbuster trilogy The Lord of the Rings have reunited to present Billy and Dom Eat the World a fun-packed, six-part travel and food series. Known throughout the world as Middle Earth Hobbits Merry and Pippin, the two real-life best friends have now travelled the globe on a string of exciting adventures discovering fascinating food and quirky secrets in six very different and special locations.

Billy and Dom are passionate about food and travel and were keen to make a show which explores the world and discovers how food and drink can give a real insight into a place, its people and its culture.

name: Iss Pyaar Ko Kya Naam Doon? 3
summary: When a dreaded past haunts Chandni and Advay's love life, she is ready to bear the burden for the sake of love, but Advay struggles with his quest for revenge.

previousepisode.name: The Diaries of a Prussian Lieutenant Colonel

name: Dawn is Breaking
summary: On her wedding day with the Crown Prince, Li Chi, the daughter of the Xie family, Xie Wanyin, stumbled upon a cruel hunt: the ever-virtuous State Preceptor, Dongfang Zui, shot the Emperor's father-in-law to death, unflinchingly and with a smile on his face. The State Preceptor has targeted Xie Wanyin since then. Expectedly, Dongfang Zui's conspiracy leads to a shocking turn of events concerning her wedding with the Crown Prince. However, to Xie Wanyin's surprise, Dongfang Zui is not trying to get rid of her. Instead, threatening to harm the entire Xie family, he forces Xie Wanyin to become his wife. Everyone assumes the State Preceptor to be broad-minded. Only Xie Wanyin knows that he is nothing but a brutal, atrocious lunatic. Uncompromising and bold, she makes up her mind to kill this crazy man. On their wedding night, Xie Wanyin decides to execute the plan she has long prepared for. Unexpectedly, smiling brightly, Dongfang Zui looks at the dagger in Xie Wanyin's hands. He grabs her hands and puts the dagger into his heart. "Dear, you could have just told me that you're killing me. There was no need for all this hassle. "That marks the beginning of their duel. Yet, she gradually comes to realize that Dongfang Zui looks similar to someone she met when she was a child. And unbeknown to both, a conspiracy spanning two generations is slowly showing its fangs.

name: 1818 Newsroom
summary: Recently graduated, Yao Fa started working as a trainee reporter for the "1818" program, determined to pursue genuine journalism. However, during interviews, he encountered various eccentric characters and situations. Under the guidance of seasoned journalist Wei Lai, he navigated a series of absurd yet humorous public interest stories. Through these experiences, Yao Fa gradually understood the core values and responsibilities of a public interest journalist, resolutely moving towards his dreams.

name: Iss Pyaar Ko Kya Naam Doon?
summary: A perfect story of opposites attract, where Khushi, a simple girl and Arnav, an arrogant businessman realise that they cannot live without each other.

name: A Flower on the Continent
summary: When Prince Ning Xuanzhou became a hostage in a rival country, he found himself forcefully rooming with Master Hua on the very first day. However, Hua Xiyu, who had been disguising herself as a man since childhood, mistakenly believed that Ning Xuanzhou, the secret spy leader, was a princess. Their fake friendship blossomed into a real romance. As for the villainous forces that sought to ignite a war between the two countries and tear them apart, they were joyfully defeated by the couple working hand in hand.

name: Fairy Charge Forward
summary: The lucky and fortunate young master Xiao Ziqi from Yongzhou City, is unexpectedly kidnapped by Zheng Lipei, the unlucky leader of Changliu Mountain, and taken to her mountain stronghold as her "captive husband." What was originally a peaceful place, Changliu Mountain, transforms into a battleground between the rival states of Shao and Yong. The two adversaries, now entangled in a struggle for power, embark on a journey of adventurous love while defending their homeland.

name: Strange Tales of Jiang Cheng
summary: In the early years of the Republic of China, the situation in Jiangzhou in the southwest region was chaotic, which led to frequent spies. Qin Huo Le, who returned from studying abroad, met the detective captain Song He and worked together to explore the secrets. With the help of female forensic doctor Fan Xiao Fan, the three of them used their sincerity and wisdom to clear the bloody fog that shrouded the people and protect justice in the world.

name: Strange Things in DaYan
summary: One bizarre murder after another unfolded, leading to a catastrophic bloodbath that wiped out an entire clan. As the reserve constable Ding Buwen grappled with the unexpected loss of his family and the departure of a close friend, he uncovered the harsh truths hidden behind layers of deceitful events. Along this journey, he developed a deep bond and romance with the enigmatic traveling physician Mo Sangyu, while also forming alliances. Through a complex web of hatred and warmth, he experienced an inspiring story of growth and resilience.

name: The Resilient Dr. Ling
summary: The intelligent and courageous modern medical doctor Ling Ruo Jin finds herself transported back in time, reincarnated as a weak and unattractive woman in ancient times. She was forced into marriage with the cold-faced prince Xiao Ye Han, who despises her. She armed with her advanced medical skills and a bold, assertive personality, Ling Ruo Jin fights back fiercely, crushing her enemies, exposing the hypocrites, and ultimately achieving a fulfilling life.

name: Chasing Glory: Road to Paris 2024
summary: Follow six incredible athletes as they prepare to compete in the biggest sporting event on the planet. From record holders to aspiring medal prospects, each athlete is chasing glory at the 2024 Summer Olympics. The countdown to Paris is on.

name: Icons Unearthed: Harry Potter
summary: Through a revolving door of directors, an assortment of magical creatures, increasing demand for visual effects, and a cast that is growing up, the Harry Potter series fascinated audiences.

name: Territory
summary: When the world's largest cattle station is left without a clear successor, generational clashes threaten to tear the mighty Lawson family apart. Sensing this once great dynasty is in decline, the outback's most powerful factions – rival cattle barons, desert gangsters, Indigenous elders and billionaire miners – move in for the kill.

name: Wuliao Jiu Wanjie
summary: Men Ke, a social animal working as an office worker, was so bored in the first half of her life that she doubted her life, but in the second half of her life, she will die of boredom. How can the Earth heroine, who faces the threat of death every day but continues to go to work, and the alien hero, who is enthusiastic and wants to save her but is not very good at it, overcome boredom and live with a smile!

previousepisode.name: Since Things Have Come to This, Let's Eat First

name: Cubeez
summary: The adventures of Bozz, Doody, Dink and Tizzy - four cube-shaped characters.

name: Pili-Pala
summary: For the youngest children.

name: Bilidowcar
summary: Bilidowcar was a television magazine programme for children .

name: Lili Lon
summary: The adventures of Lili Lon the doll and her friends.

name: Romesh Ranganathan's Parents' Evening
summary:
Celebrities will be teaming up with their daughters, sons, mums or dads in the show where it doesn't matter what you know, it's what your mother and father think you know.

Packed full of huge laughs and enormous embarrassment, the contestants' fortunes lie in the hands of those supposed to know them the best… their parents. Likewise, Romesh will be doing his best to keep his own mum, Shanthi happy as she helps oversee proceedings and the team scores, as well as keeping Romesh in check!

name: Pili Pala
summary: Sara Morris is excellent in her job. A specialist in the Department of Fetal Medicine, she loves bringing new lives into the world and is determined to give every woman the best possible experience when giving birth to their child, despite the lack of funding and lack of staff in the department. When her friend Elin asks Sara to look after her she accepts immediately, against the advice of her colleagues. She is so happy for her friend who is pregnant after years of failure and pain. But when complications arise Sara is put in an impossible situation.

name: Worst Ex Ever
summary: The end of their relationship marked the start of a nightmare. This docuseries examines the dark truths lurking within seemingly loving partners.

name: Tajemnica Sagali
summary: Eight-years old Kuba is on the trail of a magic stone, which pieces float somewhere in the world. If he puts the pieces together, the magic stone will bring happiness and prosperity to everyone. In search of the magic bits, Kuba and his brother travel through time and space visiting an ancient Gaul pre-Slavic Biskupin.

name: Deadly Case Files
summary: Deadly Case Files will bring viewers into the heart of complex homicide investigations and showcase the unwavering dedication some of the country's toughest detectives used to crack the case. Joined by Detectives Velazquez and Quinn, these veteran detectives will share their stories with a captivating mix of suspense, drama, and real-life sleuthing.

name: Crime Patrol - City Crimes
summary: Crime Patrol - City Crimes follows city police forces as they deep dive into urban crime ecosystems while investigating gang activity and cyber-crime, alongside other violent crimes, to bring the perpetrators to justice.

name: Crime Patrol Dial 100
summary: Crime Patrol Dial 100 attempts to bring stories of crime happening all around the country. Crimes that tell us that we need to be careful, we need to be watchful. Crimes that tell us lives could have been saved. Every crime we hear of, either warns us to be careful or scares us, it could happen to us. Every crime ignites a feeling, It should not have happened. Would knowing the Why? behind a crime, help in stopping a crime from happening?

name: Fresh Out Live
summary: The biggest music and pop culture news of the week, featuring artist interviews, studio performances, albums and tour announcements.

name: Crime Patrol 2.0
summary: Crime Patrol 2.0 is the New Crime Patrol series wherein our objective is to tell our viewers about the crime which happen/May happen around them. One of the data suggests most of the crime which happens in our country is done by people whom the victims already knew and our purpose is to depict those stories where crime has been done by someone close to the victim. Our show communicates the message to be aware of the surroundings we live in so that we do not fall prey to such evil-minded people. In addition to the safety message, New seasons' major addition is that new stories go deep into our cop's world to explore the nitty-gritty of their day to day activities even exploring their personal lives and their personal characters.

name: Crime Patrol 48 Hours
summary: Without a major breakthrough within the first 48 hours of a crime, the chances of solving it are cut in half. Crime Patrol 48 Hours follows the police who combine quick thinking, exceptional detective work and seamless coordination as they chase down leads to capture the culprit within a short span of 48 hours.

name: American Godfathers: The Five Families
summary: American Godfathers: The Five Families, executive produced and narrated by Emmy Award-winning actor Michael Imperioli is a three-part, six-hour documentary series exploring the inception, rise, and fall of New York City's five Mafia families who over a fifty-plus-year period had a hand in every facet of organized crime in America from bootlegging and drug trafficking to extortion and gambling. Based upon Selwyn Raab's New York Times best-seller Five Families: The Rise, Decline and Resurgence of America's Most Powerful Mafia Empires, American Godfathers: The Five Families traces the extensive history of the Mafia beginning with its early ties to Sicily. The history and subsequent breakdown of the "omerta" code coupled with the ever-changing violent power struggles within each of the five families is vividly chronicled throughout each two-hour episode. Through investigative archival images, footage, audio recordings, and recreation as well as new, candid on-camera interviews with authors including Raab himself, historians, experts, law enforcement, witnesses, and former mafia affiliates, viewers will get an inside look at the inner workings of the most powerful criminal organization of the twentieth century.

name: Hotel do Rio
summary: Everything happens in a weekend, in a provincial hotel, near a river. A family threatened by the hotel's bankruptcy and torn apart by jealousy and heartbreaks, but above all by the inability of loving and being a mother. Three groups of guests install themselves there in that weekend, looking for solutions to solve their crises. In this hotel's closed space, near the water, loves and heartbreaks, frustrating lives and harmful passions are revealed.

name: What Comes After Love
summary: Five years have passed since Hong Yi has left Japan and Joon Go. Nearing thirty, Hong Yi works at her father's publishing firm and has spent the last few years trying to forget. But when Joon Go, now a famous writer, comes to Korea to promote his new book, Hong Yi confronts past memories of love, yearning, and heartbreak. When they finally meet, it's as if no time has passed at all. Both lovers are still trapped in old memories.

name: Кто НЕ хочет стать миллионером?
summary: Nine people were selected to participate in the show, who had no idea what they had to do and what the essence of the game was. They were placed in an underground bunker, in which there was no connection with the outside world: phones, watches and other devices were prohibited. The winner of $1 million was chosen by the participants themselves by voting (you cannot vote for yourself). In order for a participant to become a winner, everyone else had to vote for him at the same time. The essence of the game is that between voting, participants tell others about themselves and how they would spend their winnings (and they can lie). Based on what they hear, the rest decide who they will vote for.

name: Jackson & Malone
summary: The series by director Max Porcelijn follows two detectives who investigate the murder of three elderly women. The story takes place in the idyllic Spulne, where three elderly women are brutally murdered. To solve the case, it is decided to use the most serious means: detectives Jackson and Malone from the all-powerful Extreme Crime Combat Service. As the pair are drawn deeper and deeper into the world of the striking residents of Spulne, they will eventually have to face their own demons to unravel the mystery.

name: Le avventure di Bernie
summary: After a failed attempt to help Zig eat Marina, Bernie is now lost at the bottom of the ocean! In this hostile environment, our genius inventor relentlessly tries – with strategies always crazier than the last – to return to his island and reunite with Zig. But with his new clumsy and wacky neighbors, it sure won't be easy.

name: Unspeakable Longing
summary: Bai Youke accidentally enters the comic book world she created, becoming the female protagonist. To return to reality, she must make the male lead, Xu Zeyu, who suffers from gynophobia, fall in love with her. Bai Youke has no choice but to pursue Xu Zeyu, yet gradually develops genuine feelings for him. However, things are far more complicated than they seem, as a fateful blood curse and a sinister plot targeting them quietly unfolds...

name: The Lady Commander
summary: Lin Yue er, the daughter of a military family, learns that her father, Lin Haotian, lost the battle of Shuozhou under suspicious circumstances. She adopts the alias "Ting Wu" and infiltrates the Guo residence as a singer to uncover the truth. Lin Yue er carefully navigates each challenge using her intelligence, ultimately seeking justice for the tens of thousands of loyal souls in the Lin family's army.

name: Ancient Workplace, Love Handbook
summary: Xu Xinglan just starts her career but unexpectedly travels back to ancient times and is bound to her assassination target—the second young master of Anjin City, Yuwen Yan! Through a series of twists and turns, they embark on a "catching game" filled with love and conflict. Using her modern mindset, she begins a remarkable journey in Anjin City, transforming from the "No. 1 Female Assassin" to the "No. 1 Female Official."

name: Erlong Lake: Blossoms of Hometown Dreams
summary: Security Zhang Hao bragged to his villagers in Erlong Lake village. To cover it up, he had to transform into a commercial genius, claiming to have brought "enormous investments" back with him and returned with a "professional team". His return coincided with his long-time friend, Li Minghan, a graduate student who had devoted herself wholeheartedly to her hometown's development and rural revitalization efforts. In this unique context of northeastern rural China, where the two people vastly differ in terms of their origins, working styles, and educational backgrounds, they offer a series of punch lines that harmoniously blend differences. As the hope of the entire village, Zhang Hao, unwittingly becomes the common target of 'tiger parenting' and at the same time, eager for success but lacking both business acumen and experience, becomes a prey to the scams.

name: The Best Day of My Life
